name: Chicken Teriyaki Bowl
reasons: Technique baked -> pan_fry; follow the stored preparation steps, not the dish title.

steps.display_text: Mix soy sauce, mirin, sake, and sugar to make teriyaki sauce.
Score chicken thighs and pan-fry skin-side down over medium-high heat for 5–6 minutes.
Flip and cook another 4 minutes. Pour in teriyaki sauce and simmer until thick and glossy.
Cook steamed rice according to packet.
Slice chicken and serve over rice. Spoon sauce on top, garnish with sesame and green onion.

name: Chicken Tikka Masala
reasons: Include the minimum stated 60 min marinade; the longer 2 h option is optional.

steps.display_text: Marinate chicken chunks in yogurt, tikka masala spice, and lemon juice for 1–2 hours.
Grill marinated chicken under a hot broiler until slightly charred. Set aside.
Fry onion in butter until golden. Add ginger-garlic paste and fry 2 minutes.
Add crushed tomatoes and spices. Simmer 15 minutes.
Blend the sauce until smooth. Return to pan, add cream.
Add grilled chicken and simmer 10 minutes. Serve with basmati rice and naan.

name: Chocolate Mousse
reasons: Technique baked -> removed (no supported no-bake taxonomy); follow the stored preparation steps, not the dish title.

steps.display_text: Melt dark chocolate with butter over a bain-marie. Stir smooth and cool slightly.
Separate eggs. Whisk yolks with sugar until pale. Mix into chocolate.
Whip cream to soft peaks. Whip egg whites to stiff peaks.
Fold cream into chocolate mixture, then gently fold in egg whites in two additions.
Pour into serving glasses. Refrigerate at least 3 hours.
Serve with a dollop of lightly whipped cream and chocolate shavings.

name: Club Sandwich
reasons: Technique raw -> grilled; follow the stored preparation steps. Cold assembled dishes use the existing raw category, which does not imply all ingredients are uncooked.

steps.display_text: Season chicken breast and grill or pan-fry until cooked through. Rest and slice.
Cook bacon until crispy. Toast three slices of bread.
Spread mayo on all three toast slices.
First layer: lettuce, tomato, chicken on bottom toast. Add middle toast.
Second layer: bacon, more lettuce. Top with the third slice of toast.
Secure with four toothpicks and cut diagonally into four triangles.

name: Croissant
reasons: Technique fried -> baked; follow the stored preparation steps, not the dish title.
Estimate 45 min active work, 20 min baking, initial 60 min chill, four 30 min chills (initial fold plus repeat 3 times), and 120 min proof. Fold-count wording still needs recipe-editor confirmation.
Remove the under-30 tag because corrected elapsed time exceeds 30 minutes.

steps.display_text: Make a lean dough from flour, yeast, milk, sugar, and a little butter. Chill 1 hour.
Create a butter block by pounding cold butter into a flat square. Chill.
Encase butter block in the dough. Roll out and fold in thirds (letter fold). Chill 30 minutes. Repeat 3 times.
Roll out dough 4 mm thick. Cut into long triangles.
Roll each triangle from base to tip. Curve into a crescent on a baking sheet.
Proof 2 hours at room temperature until puffy. Brush with egg wash. Bake at 200°C for 15–18 minutes.

name: Croque Monsieur
reasons: Technique raw -> baked; follow the stored preparation steps. Cold assembled dishes use the existing raw category, which does not imply all ingredients are uncooked.

steps.display_text: Make a small béchamel: melt butter, stir in flour, then add warm milk gradually. Season with nutmeg and salt.
Spread Dijon mustard on one slice of bread. Add ham and grated Gruyère. Top with second slice.
Spread béchamel on top of the sandwich. Sprinkle with more Gruyère.
Bake or grill until cheese is bubbling and deep golden. Serve hot.

name: Dolma (Turkish Stuffed Vine Leaves)
reasons: Technique fried -> simmered; follow the stored preparation steps, not the dish title.

steps.display_text: Sauté diced onion until soft. Add raw rice, pine nuts, currants, and spices. Cook 2 minutes.
Rinse vine leaves in hot water to soften. Pat dry.
Place a vine leaf vein-side up. Add a small amount of filling. Fold sides in and roll tightly.
Pack tightly in a pot, seam-side down. Add olive oil, lemon juice, and water to just cover.
Weight down with a plate. Simmer on low heat for 45 minutes.
Cool completely in the pot. Serve at room temperature with lemon wedges and yogurt.

name: Double Smash Burger
reasons: Onions take up to 30 min before the burger is cooked; allow another 5 min for the patties.

steps.display_text: Slowly caramelise onions in butter for 25–30 minutes until deep golden and jammy.
Divide beef into two loose 90g balls. Don't compact them.
Heat cast iron pan over high heat until very hot. Place beef ball on pan and smash flat with a spatula.
Season with salt and pepper. Cook 90 seconds without touching until edges are crispy.
Flip and immediately place cheese on top. Repeat with second patty.
Toast bun, add sauce, stack both patties, caramelised onion, and pickles. Press gently and serve.

name: Döner Kebab
reasons: Technique raw -> grilled; follow the stored preparation steps. Cold assembled dishes use the existing raw category, which does not imply all ingredients are uncooked.

steps.display_text: Slice the lamb or chicken thinly and season with salt and a little sumac.
Cook the meat on a very hot grill pan or under a broiler in thin layers, turning frequently until browned and lightly charred.
Warm the flatbread on a dry pan or briefly under the broiler.
Slice the tomato and onion and finely shred the cabbage.
Fill the flatbread with meat, cabbage, tomato, onion, garlic sauce, and red pepper sauce. Wrap and serve.

name: Egg Fried Rice
reasons: Technique simmered -> stir_fry; follow the stored preparation steps. Cold assembled dishes use the existing raw category, which does not imply all ingredients are uncooked.

steps.display_text: Use day-old cold rice for best results — fresh rice is too wet.
Heat wok over very high heat until smoking. Add oil and minced garlic, stir for 30 seconds.
Add rice and press it against the hot wok surface. Toss every 30 seconds.
Push rice to the side, crack eggs in and scramble them. Mix into the rice.
Add soy sauce and sesame oil, toss well. Scatter sliced green onion and serve.
